about_the_game:
Steezelpunk blends high-speed arcade racing with retro RPG-style progression and exploration, all set in a gritty underground racetrack world.

Game Overview

From the very start of the game, you’ll find yourself dropped into a mysterious cyber-steam-diesel-punk environment, beginning in a rundown garage where every object, tunnel, and corner hints at a larger world waiting to be uncovered. As you start to explore, you’ll race through twisting, maze-like tracks designed not just to test your reflexes, but also your ability to adapt, memorize routes, and find optimal lines.

Every track is full of hazards, alternate routes, and hidden shortcuts - making situational awareness and precision control just as vital as acceleration. You’ll have to study each environment and adjust your approach dynamically to stay ahead. As you progress, you’ll also unlock abilities that change how you interact with the environment, opening up new paths or helping you avoid obstacles more effectively.

Progression

In addition to performance upgrades, tons of unique skins let you personalize your ride visually. As you complete key elements of the game, the garage will also evolve visually. Meanwhile, powerful artifacts and collectible resources found throughout the game grant you passive skills and permanent enhancements that can influence how you approach each race. These combined with the Reset system creates a flexible endless experience that evolves over time.

Extended Gameplay

A full Playthrough, including the collection of all Artifacts, completion of all Quests, and unlocking all Achievements, is expected to take anywhere from 10 to 30 hours, depending on how you explore the environment.

New Game+ / Reset System

Of course, once you Reset your stats and come back Stronger, you can play and upgrade your vehicle forever. There is no upper limit.

Let’s see how far you can push the grind!

Supported Inputs

This is a Single Player indie experience, with full support for Keyboard and Mouse controls.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: 2.8 GHz dual-core processor
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 8600/9600GT or ATI/AMD Radeon HD 2400/3400 or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500K or AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970 or AMD Radeon RX 480 or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX

short_description: Steezelpunk is an indie racing game that blends high-speed retro racing with RPG exploration elements. Upgrade your stats and race through maze-like tracks. Level up your skills and loot out the map in a world where every race is a test of survival.
